$comment: The feats a level-up can grant in place of an Ability Score Improvement (the Baldur's Gate 3 list; add {"feat": id} to a class's progression in classes.json to grant one outright). Every feat is listed in the level panel; one whose requirement the hero does not meet is greyed out, and one the game does not play out yet (worked: false) is greyed out too. Fields (all optional): worked: the game plays it out. abilities: the abilities it raises by 1 (the player picks one when there are several; never above 20). requires: {armor: light|medium|heavy|shield} trained in that armour (by class or by another feat), {spellcaster: true} the hero casts spells, {abilityAtLeast: {abilities: [..], score: n}} one of those abilities at n or more. initiative: added to initiative rolls. hitPointsPerLevel: hit points every level, those of levels already gained too. armor: armour training it gives. mediumArmorDexCap: the DEX that medium armour lets count. heavyArmorReduction: damage taken off every enemy weapon blow while in heavy armour. speedFeet: feet of speed it adds. passivePerception: added to passive Perception. saveProficiency: trained in the saving throw of the ability it raised. savageDamage: weapon damage dice are rolled twice, the higher kept. dualWield: two-weapon fighting without light weapons (not heavy ones), and dualWieldArmorClass more AC with a melee weapon in each hand. unarmedStrengthTwice: STR counts twice to hit and to damage bare-handed. shortRestFullHeal: a short rest heals every hit point. New effects need a field here, a reader in src/rules/Feats.ts and a hook where the rule applies. Names and descriptions: texts.json, feat.<id>.name/description.
